scope: isolated window-local candidate fusion; no current platform/Subject consumer and no new authority
change: Combine local window decoded frames, original dsh cues and local adjacent-frame proposals using existing budget/gap planning; convert planned times back to original container-relative seconds and integer source PTS/time_base.
input_contract: DecodedFrames with caller-supplied source, exact original PTS, window and RGB, plus dsh/local pair outputs bound to identical caller source, decoded geometry and frame counts. Matching references do not independently authenticate bytes, account or privacy.
output_contract: Window-only candidate source times, exact pts_tick/time_base, caller source reference, source and scaled pixel geometry, selected crop boxes and selected sides, explicit backpressure/truncation and sampling gaps. whole_window_observed is always false. No image stored, model called or output treated as delivery.

controlled_results.offset_vfr: container origin 5s, requested [0.6,2.1); actual source-relative frames 1.75/2.0 with original ticks survive original dsh and budget fusion; cross-source, wrong geometry, invalid crop and altered tick rejected
controlled_results.long_tail: 601s synthetic 1fps; requested [599,601) decodes and fuses 599/600s with matching original PTS; no full-video watch claim
controlled_results.empty: VFR window [0.6,1.6) yields no new frame, unknown interval rather than blank scene or inferred observation
controlled_results.initial_failure: First integration test exposed a missing RGB bytes-per-pixel factor (one failed); fixed size validation to width × height × 3, retained assertion.

limits: No real Bilibili/QQ account, actual platform source, long-GOP user media, billed model, token, OCR/ASR, device or production qualification
Source ID equality and geometry/count checks cannot authenticate frame bytes, account, privacy or physical source; caller and original authority must verify
Any crop box is in decoded scaled unrotated pixels and still must be revalidated against actual frame; held previous VFR frame is not inferred
No original Memory/Kernel lineage persistence or automatic withdrawal of returned in-memory objects
Overall video scope and other windows are not observed; gap list reports only spans larger than configured sampling threshold
next: B validates long-GOP/edit-list/timebase edge cases and resource costs; NanaLink supplies authenticated source; A integrates original S5/Memory/Provider budget and withdrawal
